construction.implementation_origin: Newly authored isolated reference implementation; no existing implementation copied or inspected

records.patient: FHIR-style Patient with synthetic alias, broad age band, fictitious coded diagnoses and numeric labs
records.clinical_note: FHIR-style DocumentReference linking the patient to canonical synthetic clinical note text
records.prior_authorization_request: FHIR-style draft Claim with preauthorization purpose, document checklist and administrative workflow fields

shared_schema.validation: validate_envelope checks the same strict envelope at input and before/after every stage. It validates references, finite values, controlled text, stage prefix, deterministic grounded stage output and complete audit replay.
shared_schema.output_state: Same envelope with four validated stages, audit events and authorization workflow_status=awaiting-human-review
shared_schema.errors: Single JSON object with status=error and exit 2; no rejected identifiers or paths echoed

cross_stage_handoffs.data: Patient age band, experience, goal, format preference and authorization document gaps
Validated next step and goal, used for contextual response and empty-question fallback
Validated intent, evidence source and normalized query terms; clinical requests are redirected to records administration
Validated administrative resource candidates and relevance scores; recommendations must be a subset of these candidates

behavior.onboarding: Personalized new/returning customer or caregiver next step and missing-document checklist
behavior.support: Deterministic offline retrieval from seven fixed knowledge entries, source citations, uncertainty escalation and clinical refusal
behavior.search: Bounded typo correction, synonym normalization, deterministic lexical ranking, language and accessibility filters
behavior.recommend: Reranks only search results by stated interests and preferred format; bounded output and explicit human next step
behavior.optional_responder: Injected Python callable receives only approved support evidence. Exact answer/source matching is mandatory; tested using local fixture callables only.
behavior.privacy: Rejects direct identifier fields, exact dates, non-synthetic aliases, noncanonical notes and request text outside bounded synthetic vocabulary. No arbitrary real-patient ingestion or claim of HIPAA Safe Harbor certification.
behavior.clinical_safety: No diagnosis, lab interpretation, treatment recommendation, authorization approval or submission. All records and stage outputs require human review.
behavior.audit: Every changed record field receives ordered before/after evidence with stage, actor, record reference and human-review flag. Input is deep-copied; patient and clinical note remain immutable.
behavior.synthetic_fixture: Hand-authored fictitious Synthea-style patient, diagnosis and lab values, explicitly tagged synthetic; no real names, MRNs or birth dates.

included: One executable integrated pipeline and shared validator
Three linked healthcare entities in a FHIR-style JSON envelope
Bounded English conversational vocabulary with synonyms and typo tolerance
English grounded support answers explicitly labeled en, and en/es catalog availability
Administrative-resource product catalog, explainable search and preference-based discovery
Deterministic audit replay and synthetic privacy rejection controls
Local injected-response fixtures and CLI error handling
excluded: Real patient information or general-purpose PHI sanitization
HIPAA compliance certification or full FHIR conformance
Clinical decisions, clinical product selection or interpretation of diagnosis/lab data
Live LLMs, network services, payer integrations or autonomous submissions
Authentication, persistent storage, production tamper-resistant logging
Arbitrary unrestricted clinical notes or unrestricted multilingual text

test_outcomes.cli_example: passed: one JSON object, status=ok, all four pipeline stages and five audited record changes
test_outcomes.cli_error_behavior: Verified missing files, directories, invalid JSON, invalid schema, duplicate keys, non-finite JSON numbers, oversized input and invalid argument count produce status=error and exit 2
coverage: Each stage and every cross-stage handoff
Personalization, synonyms, typos, empty context and no results
Synthetic identifier, controlled note and human-review constraints
Clinical refusal and prevention of autonomous authorization approval
Determinism, immutable clinical records and full administrative audit replay
Tampered stage outputs and audit records
Accepted, ungrounded, mutating and failing injected responder fixtures
